name: @1delta-x/raffle-admin
description: Operator console for the Rootstock prize draw: configuration, test mode, feedback, support cases and the daily draws. Deployed on its own, never part of the trading app.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @1delta-x/sdk build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && vite build
scripts.deploy: pnpm build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name raffle-admin-1delta --branch main
